description: This file defines the CustomerGroup controller class for the OpenCart admin interface, handling CRUD operations for customer groups including listing, form display, save, and delete functionalities.

classes.name: CustomerGroup
classes.description: Controller class for managing customer groups in the admin area, includes methods for listing, form handling, saving, and deleting customer groups.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initial method that loads language, sets page title, builds breadcrumbs, and displays the list of customer groups.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the list view of customer groups with pagination and sorting.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Prepares and returns the HTML view for listing customer groups based on current filters, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing a customer group.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles the saving of a customer group, either creating or updating based on the request data.
